system.description:
PROWLER SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000347]{Trophy Arms} 【Max SL 5】

During a rest or camp, craft harvested materials from slain creatures into weapons using the Trophy Arms tables. You may keep at most (SL) unique such weapons at a time, but may overwrite them freely.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000348]{Grudge} 【Max SL 3】

Your hunted-creature list holds (SL) creature types; one slot is fixed to your home region's most common hostile type, and the rest may be swapped during a rest in a city or settlement. Resources and rewards from hunted creatures have their zenit value increased by (SL x 5) percent.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000349]{Mithridatism} 【Max SL 3】

Damage you take from hunted creatures is reduced by (SL) before Affinities, or by (SL x 2) before Affinities if you are Resistant to that damage type.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000350]{Reputation} 【Max SL 4】

At the start of a conflict, choose dazed or slow; every hunted creature in the scene immediately suffers it. A hunted creature you afflicted must succeed a (WLP + WLP) Opposed Check against you to recover from that status, otherwise it fails. You gain +(SL) to your Checks for this skill.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000351]{Prime Cut} 【Max SL 3】

When you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points or force it to retreat, you always instantly receive a forageable or harvestable material from it worth (SL x enemy level x 2), regardless of how it died or escaped. You may combine two raw materials harvested from hunted creatures into one item of their summed value during a rest or camp.
